```{r, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(colorspace)
library(ggh4x)

type <- "KEGG" 
pyth <- "combi_out_ot/corona/evaluation/gprofiler/"

gprofile_reader <- function(type, path) {
  files <- list.files(
    path = path,
    pattern = paste0(type, "\\.sub_enriched_pathways\\.tsv$"),
    recursive = TRUE,
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  transformed_names <- basename(files) %>%
    str_remove("\\.gprofiler2.*") %>%
    str_remove("\\.string_\\d+") %>%
    str_remove("\\.ppi_plus_virus_\\w+") %>%
    str_remove("\\.(\\w+)\\.\\1$") %>%
    str_replace_all("\\.", "_")
  datalist <- files %>%
    set_names(transformed_names) %>%
    map(~ read_tsv(.x))
  data_list_combi <- datalist %>% imap_dfr(~ .x %>% mutate(source = .y))
  return(data_list_combi)
}

gprofile_reader2 <- function(type, path) {
  files <- list.files(
    path = path,
    pattern = paste0(type, "\\.sub_enriched_pathways\\.tsv$"),
    recursive = TRUE,
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  transformed_names <- basename(files) %>%
    str_remove("\\.gprofiler2.*") %>%
    str_remove("\\.(\\w+)\\.\\1$") %>%
    str_replace_all("\\.", "_")
  datalist <- files %>%
    set_names(transformed_names) %>%
    map(~ read_tsv(.x))
  data_list_combi <- datalist %>% imap_dfr(~ .x %>% mutate(source = .y))
  return(data_list_combi)
}

get_kegg_data <- function(dataset, pathway_code, filter = FALSE){
  methods <- c("diamond", "domino", "no_tool", "rwr", "robust", "robust_bias_aware", "firstneighbor")
  method_pattern <- paste0("(", paste(methods, collapse = "|"), ")$")
  dataset_pathway <- dataset %>%
    mutate(source = str_remove(source, "_uniprot")) %>%
    mutate(method = str_extract(source, method_pattern)) %>%
    mutate(dataset = ifelse(str_detect(source, "hvidb"), "HVIDB", NA)) %>%
    mutate(dataset = ifelse(str_detect(source, "intact"), "IntAct", dataset)) %>%
    mutate(dataset = ifelse(str_detect(source, "targets"), "Open Targets", dataset)) %>%
    mutate(seed = ifelse(str_detect(source, "human_seeds"), "Human Seeds", "Viral Seeds")) %>%
    mutate(seed = ifelse(str_detect(source, "targets"), "Human Seeds", seed)) %>%
    filter(Pathway_code == pathway_code)
  
  if(!filter){
    dataset_map <- tibble(
      seed = c("Human Seeds", "Viral Seeds", "Human Seeds", "Viral Seeds", "Human Seeds"),
      dataset = c("IntAct", "IntAct", "HVIDB", "HVIDB", "Open Targets"),
    )
    
    full_combos <- tidyr::crossing(method = methods, dataset_map)
    joiner = c("method", "seed", "dataset")
  }else{
    dataset_map <- tibble(
      seed = c("Human Seeds", "Viral Seeds", "Human Seeds"),
      dataset = c("IntAct", "IntAct", "Open Targets"),
    )
    full_combos <- tidyr::crossing(method = methods, 
                                   dataset_map, 
                                   filter = unique(dataset_pathway$filter))
    joiner = c("method", "seed", "dataset", "filter")
  }
  
  pathway_complete <- full_combos %>%
      left_join(dataset_pathway, by = joiner) %>%
      mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~replace_na(.x, 0))) %>%
      mutate(Padj = ifelse(Padj == 0, 1, Padj))
  
  return(pathway_complete)
}
  
get_human_kegg_data <- function(dataset, pathway_code){
  methods <- c("diamond", "domino", "no_tool", "rwr", "robust",
               "robust_bias_aware", "firstneighbor", "firstneighbor")
  filters <- c("top_50", "top_100")
  networks <- c("String 700", "virus+human edges", "virus edges")
  method_pattern <- paste0("(", paste(methods, collapse = "|"), ")$")
  
  dataset_pathway <- dataset %>%
    mutate(source = str_remove(source, "_uniprot")) %>%
    mutate(method = str_extract(source, method_pattern)) %>%
    mutate(filter = str_extract(source, "top_(50|100)")) %>%
    mutate(network = case_when(
      str_detect(source, "string_700") ~ "String 700",
      str_detect(source, "ppi_plus_virus.*human_int") ~ "virus+human edges",
      str_detect(source, "ppi_plus_virus") ~ "virus edges",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )) %>%
    filter(Pathway_code == pathway_code)
  
  full_combos <- tidyr::crossing(
    method = methods,
    filter = filters,
    network = networks
  )
  joiner <- c("method", "network", "filter")
  
  pathway_complete <- full_combos %>%
    left_join(dataset_pathway, by = joiner) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~replace_na(.x, 0))) %>%
    mutate(Padj = ifelse(Padj == 0, 1, Padj))
  
  return(pathway_complete)
}
```

```{r}
get_categories_kegg_data <- function(dataset, pathway_code){
  methods <- c("diamond", "domino", "no_tool", "rwr", "robust",
               "robust_bias_aware", "firstneighbor")
  categories <- c("expansion", "interaction_type", "clinical", "interactive")
  method_pattern <- paste0("(", paste(methods, collapse = "|"), ")$")
  
  dataset_pathway <- dataset %>%
    mutate(categorised_by = str_extract(source, paste(categories, collapse = "|"))) %>%
    mutate(categorised_by = categorised_by %>% replace_values(
      "expansion" ~ "Expansion Method", 
      "interaction_type" ~ "Interaction Type", 
      "clinical" ~ "Clinical", 
      "interactive" ~ "Tractability"
    )) %>%
    mutate(method = str_extract(source, method_pattern)) %>%
    mutate(seed = case_when(
      str_detect(source, "targets") ~ "Human Seeds",
      str_detect(source, "virus") ~ "Viral Seeds",
      .default = "Human Seeds"
    )) %>%
    mutate(dataset = case_when(
      str_detect(source, "targets") ~ "Open Targets",
      .default = "IntAct"
    )) %>%
    filter(Pathway_code == pathway_code)
  
  category_dataset_map <- tibble::tibble(
    categorised_by = c("Expansion Method", "Interaction Type","Expansion Method", "Interaction Type", "Clinical", "Tractability"),
    dataset         = c("IntAct", "IntAct", "IntAct", "IntAct", "Open Targets", "Open Targets"),
    seed = c("Human Seeds", "Viral Seeds","Viral Seeds","Human Seeds", "Human Seeds", "Human Seeds"),
  )
  full_combos <- tidyr::crossing(method = methods, category_dataset_map)

  joiner <- c("method", "categorised_by", "dataset", "seed")

  pathway_complete <- full_combos %>%
    left_join(dataset_pathway, by = joiner) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~replace_na(.x, 0))) %>%
    mutate(Padj = ifelse(Padj == 0, 1, Padj))
  
  return(pathway_complete)
}

get_filter_data_virus <- function(dataset, pathway_code){
  methods <- c("diamond", "domino", "no_tool", "rwr", "robust",
               "robust_bias_aware", "firstneighbor")
  networks <- c("standard", "virus+human edges", "virus edges")
  method_pattern <- paste0("(", paste(methods, collapse = "|"), ")$")
  
  dataset_pathway <- dataset %>% 
    mutate(network = case_when(
      str_detect(source, "ppi_plus_virus_intact_\\w+_standard") ~ "standard",
      str_detect(source, "ppi_plus_virus_intact_top_50_human_int") ~ "virus+human edges",
      .default = "virus edges"
    )) %>%
    mutate(method = str_extract(source, method_pattern)) %>%
    filter(Pathway_code == pathway_code)
  
  full_combos <- tidyr::crossing(method = methods, network = networks)
  
  joiner <- c("method", "network")
  
  pathway_complete <- full_combos %>%
    left_join(dataset_pathway, by = joiner) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~replace_na(.x, 0))) %>%
    mutate(Padj = ifelse(Padj == 0, 1, Padj))
  
  return(pathway_complete)
}

get_subcategories_data <- function(dataset, pathway_code){
  methods <- c("diamond", "domino", "no_tool", "rwr", "robust",
               "robust_bias_aware", "firstneighbor")
  categories <- c("entry_uncoating", "replication_transcription", "assembly_packaging", 
                  "egress_envelopment", "immune_evasion", "uncategorised")
  datasets <- c("HVIDB", "IntAct")
  organisms <- c("Viral Seeds", "Human Seeds")
  method_pattern <- paste0("(", paste(methods, collapse = "|"), ")$")
  
  dataset_pathway <- dataset %>%
    mutate(subcategory = str_extract(source, paste(categories, collapse = "|"))) %>%
    mutate(method = str_extract(source, method_pattern)) %>%
    mutate(dataset = ifelse(str_detect(source, "hvidb"), "HVIDB", "IntAct")) %>%
    mutate(organism = ifelse(str_detect(source, "virus"), "Viral Seeds", "Human Seeds")) %>%
    filter(Pathway_code == pathway_code)
  
  full_combos <- tidyr::crossing(method = methods, subcategory = categories, dataset = datasets, organism = organisms)
  joiner <- c("method", "subcategory", "dataset", "organism")
  
  pathway_complete <- full_combos %>%
    left_join(dataset_pathway, by = joiner) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~replace_na(.x, 0))) %>%
    mutate(Padj = ifelse(Padj == 0, 1, Padj))
  
  return(pathway_complete)
}
```

```{r}
corona_pathway <- get_kegg_data(corona_kegg_combi, "KEGG:05171")

corona_pathway %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Fraction_DE, y = method, fill = (Padj < 0.01))) +
  geom_col(color = "black") +
  facet_grid(seed ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#C60C12", "FALSE" = "#F6656A"), name = "Padj < 0.01") + 
  labs(x = "Enriched Fraction") + 
  theme_bw()

ggsave("plots/covid_pathway.jpeg", dpi = 300, width = 10, height = 6)

corona_pathway %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = -log10(Padj), y = method)) + 
  geom_col(color = "black", fill = "red") + 
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = -log10(0.01)), linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_grid(seed ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") + 
  theme_bw()
ggsave("plots/covid_padj.jpeg", dpi = 300, width = 10, height = 6)
```

```{r}
combined_pathway <- bind_rows(
  corona_pathway %>% mutate(virus = "SARS-CoV-2"),
  hsv_pathway    %>% mutate(virus = "HSV-1"),
  hiv_pathway    %>% mutate(virus = "HIV-1")
)

combined_pathway %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = -log10(Padj), y = method, fill = virus)) + 
  geom_col(color = "black") + 
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = -log10(0.01)), linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_nested(seed + dataset ~ virus, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = virus_colors, guide = "none") +
  theme_bw() + 
  labs(y = "Method")
ggsave("plots/pathway/combined_padj.jpeg", dpi = 300, width = 7, height = 5)


combined_pathway %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Fraction_DE, y = method, fill = virus)) +
  geom_col(color = "black") +
  facet_nested(seed + dataset ~ virus, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = virus_colors, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Enriched Fraction", y = "Method") + 
  theme_bw()

ggsave("plots/pathway/combined_pathway.jpeg", dpi = 300, width = 7, height = 5)
```

```{r}

prep_pathway_sub <- function(data, virus_data, filter_value = "top_100") {
  virus_temp <- virus_data %>% 
    filter(network == "standard") %>% 
    select(!network) %>% 
    mutate(dataset = "Virus IntAct", categorised_by = "original")
  
  data %>%
    filter(filter == filter_value) %>%
    filter(!str_detect(seed, "viral")) %>%
    mutate(dataset = case_when(
      seed == "IntAct human seeds" ~ "Human IntAct",
      seed == "IntAct viral seeds" ~ "Virus IntAct",
      .default = "Open targets"
    )) %>%
    mutate(categorised_by = "original") %>%
    select(!seed & !filter) %>%
    bind_rows(virus_temp)
  
}

corona_new_filter_pathway_sub <- prep_pathway_sub(corona_new_filter_pathway, corona_viral_filter_pathway)
hsv_new_filter_pathway_sub <- prep_pathway_sub(hsv_new_filter_pathway, hsv_viral_filter_pathway)
hiv_new_filter_pathway_sub <- prep_pathway_sub(hiv_new_filter_pathway, hiv_viral_filter_pathway)
```

```{r}
  facet_nested(seed + filter ~ virus, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = virus_colors, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Enriched Fraction") + 
  theme_bw()+ 
  labs(y = "Method")

ggsave("plots/pathway/combined_int_filter_pathway.jpeg", dpi = 300, width = 7, height = 5)
```
